environment.description: ECS Fargate task deployed in VPC subnet rtb-0x7f2a91 with route table containing only local routes (10.0.0.0/16 -> local) and a VPC endpoint for ECR/CloudWatch (vpce-03d8f). Subnet has no route to NAT gateway, internet gateway, or transit gateway. The task's ENI is assigned from this subnet. Security group sg-0a4f2b permits inbound on port 8080 from internal ALB only and has default-deny egress with exception for the VPC endpoint prefix list (pl-63a5400a for com.amazonaws.us-east-1.logs). DNS resolution returns NXDOMAIN for non-VPC-internal hostnames due to Route 53 Resolver inbound endpoint configuration with no forwarding rules for external domains.

config.security_group_egress: sg-0a4f2b: allow TCP 443 to pl-63a5400a (AWS services prefix list) only
config.dns_config: Route 53 Resolver with no forwarding rules for external zones
